title: LedgerBloom
subtitle: Invoice and payment tracking SaaS
description: A SaaS platform for tracking invoices, following up with clients, and managing receivables. Collect payments with confidence from one place with client reminders and financial tracking.
problem: Small businesses and freelancers in Uganda struggle to track outstanding invoices and follow up with clients systematically. Manual tracking in spreadsheets leads to missed payments and cash flow problems.
role: Built the full-stack application including authentication (Google and GitHub OAuth), invoice management system, client reminder workflows, and the dashboard interface.
approach: Full-stack SaaS application with modern authentication, real-time invoice tracking, automated client reminders, and a clean dashboard for financial overview. Built with a focus on simplicity and reliability for the Ugandan market.
hardestDecision: Designing the reminder system to be helpful without being intrusive — finding the right cadence and channels for client follow-ups that actually improve collection rates without damaging business relationships.
outcome: Live at ledgerbloom.ochiengpaul.com with working authentication and invoice management.
whatIdChange: Would add mobile money integration (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money) for the Ugandan market, and implement PDF invoice generation with custom branding.
